source.text: P1 4-Stage PCS with Epoch Budget: Replace single-stage PCS with a 4-stage progressive loyalty pipeline (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum) where each stage has its own epoch budget allocation curve. Tokenomics persona obligations: emissions schedule (how epoch budget distributes across tiers), vesting/unlock alignment (tier advancement gates), incentive source (which pool funds tier bonuses), assumptions challenge (are tier thresholds correctly calibrated to prevent gaming or premature tier inflation). Story: US-Z1-M3-09.
